# outcome-metrics

Micrometer outcome observations + cardinality limits for Spring Boot and Quarkus.
0.1.0-beta.2 preview · Java 21+ · config: `outcome.metrics.*`

## Artifacts

| Artifact | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `outcome-metrics` | Core: `OutcomeObservations`, `@MeasuredOutcome`, filters |
| `outcome-metrics-spring-boot-starter` | Spring Boot 4 auto-config + AOP |
| `outcome-metrics-quarkus` | Quarkus extension (preview) |
| `outcome-metrics-bom` | BOM |

## API cheat sheet

```java
observations.record("order.place", MetricsTags.pairs("channel=web"), () -> place());

@MeasuredOutcome(name = "order.reserve", tags = {"step=reserve"})
public Reservation reserve(String sku) { ... }

// domain exception
public OutcomeReason outcomeReason() { return () -> "payment_declined"; }
```

Tags: `outcome=success|failure`, `reason=none|unknown|<code>`, `integrity=ok|degraded|empty|none`.
Quiet failures: `recordClassified(name, tags, work, result -> OutcomeIntegrity.DEGRADED)` grades a
technically successful result; failures carry `integrity=none`.
Repeat storms: `try (var s = OutcomeScope.open()) { ... }` tags identical repeats per series
`occurrence=repeat` (SLIs filter `occurrence="first"`); no scope → always `first`.
Reason budget: `new OutcomeObservations(registry, new ReasonBudget(8, 64))` bounds distinct
failure codes per name (rest → `other`); `budget.expand()` restores full detail at runtime.
SLO binding: `SloCatalog.of("checkout-success").binding("checkout-success")` → `slo` KeyValue
(undeclared ids throw at wiring); `bindTo` emits `outcome.metrics.slo.info{slo}=1` per id —
alert on `absent(...)` for drift. Policy (target/window) stays in Sloth/OpenSLO.
Combination guard: `OutcomeObservationConvention.builder().combinationGuard(CombinationGuard
.builder().keys("region","product").minSupport(20).window(Duration.ofMinutes(15)).build())` —
rare tuples emit `other` until k events in one window; reveal one-way; fails closed; not k-anonymity.
Annotation firewall: add `outcome-metrics-processor` to `annotationProcessorPaths` — malformed
`@MeasuredOutcome` tag pairs / blank names fail the build; non-canonical tokens warn.
Reason registry: `OutcomeObservationConvention.builder().reasonRegistry(ReasonRegistry.builder()
.vocabulary(MyReasons.class).build()).reasonBudget(...).build()` — unregistered reasons emit
`reason=unknown` + `alertability=page` (self-silencing rogue reasons defeated); never throws.
Alert routing: override `OutcomeReason.alertability()` (`PAGE` default | `TICKET` | `NONE`);
failures emit `alertability=page|ticket|none`, successes `none`; route alerts on the tag.
Idempotency: `recordIdempotent(name, tags, work, r -> IdempotencyOutcome.APPLIED|DUPLICATE_SKIPPED)`
tags successes; failures keep `idempotency=none`; throw `IdempotencyException(IdempotencyReason.*)`
for conflict/stale/missing-key (never put keys or message ids in tags).
Shared resources: `SharedResource.owned|borrowed|pooled(type, tiers...).withPool(id).tags()` —
five fixed tags (`resource`,`relationship`,`consumer_tier`,`owner_tier`,`pool`); UUIDs rejected.
Offline sync: tag phases `OutcomePhase.INTENT|COMMIT.tag()`; `recordReconciliation(name, tags,
work, r -> ReconcileDisposition.CONFIRMED|DIVERGED|ABANDONED|DEFERRED)` adds `phase=reconcile`;
failures keep `disposition=none`; intent ids never become tags.
Overflow: remap to `other`; gauge `outcome.metrics.tag_value_overflows`.
